judgment_text:
Prayer : First Appeal filed under Section 96 of the Civil Procedure Code, to set aside the Decree and Judgment dated 19.12.2023 passed in O.S.No.lOl of 2014 on the file of the Additional District Judge, Hosur.

ORDER

G. Jayachandran, J.:— This Court directed the parties to participate in Mediation to resolve the dispute amicably. Accordingly, the parties have engaged themselves in Mediation and successfully arrived at compromise settlement.

2. Pursuant to the settlement agreement dated 13-2-2026, the disputed difference of amount was fixed as Rs.34,97,424 and the same was paid to the respondent on 9-2-2026 towards full and final settlement.

3. In view of the above, A.S. No. 215 of 2026 is disposed of in terms of the agreement. The terms of agreement as found in Paragraph No. 6 thereof, shall form part of the decree. There shall be no order as to costs.

4. The appellant is entitled for refund of Court fees as per law.
